issues.text: The async legacy write reuses the request context, which is canceled as soon as the request ends, so mode 3's dual write systematically only completes half.
issues.zh: 非同步 legacy 寫入沿用 request context，請求一結束就被取消，mode 3 的雙寫會系統性地只寫成一半

issues.text: Delete sends the object name as the Prometheus 'kind' label, giving the label cardinality no bound.
issues.zh: Delete 把物件名稱當成 kind label 送進 Prometheus，標籤基數沒有上限

issues.text: Failures in the background legacy write only go into a metric with no logging, and the goroutine has no panic recovery.
issues.zh: 背景 legacy 寫入的失敗只進 metric、沒有任何 log，goroutine 也沒有 panic recovery

issues.text: Three metrics are recorded into the wrong histogram: storage failures are recorded as legacy, and legacy calls are recorded as storage.
issues.zh: 三處 metric 記進了錯誤的 histogram：storage 失敗記成 legacy、legacy 呼叫記成 storage

issues.text: Delete / DeleteCollection now return immediately on any storage error, so the legacy side is no longer cleaned up (it used to deliberately tolerate NotFound).
issues.zh: Delete / DeleteCollection 改成 storage 一出錯就 return，legacy 端不再被清理（原本刻意容忍 NotFound）

issues.text: The three new playlist 'mode 3' integration tests actually run in mode 1; not a single line of this change's production code is covered.
issues.zh: 新增的三個 playlist 「mode 3」整合測試實際上跑在 mode 1，本次的正式碼一行都沒被涵蓋

issues.text: The mode 3 unit tests never verify the async write to the legacy side, which is the whole point of mode 3.
issues.zh: mode 3 的單元測試完全沒有驗證 legacy 端的非同步寫入，而那正是 mode 3 的定義

issues.text: Four write methods each duplicate the same goroutine + 10-second timeout boilerplate.
issues.zh: 四個寫入方法各自複製一份 goroutine + 10 秒 timeout 樣板

issues.text: Delete puts the unenriched d.Log into the context, so the name/kind/method fields all disappear downstream.
issues.zh: Delete 把未加值的 d.Log 放進 context，name / kind / method 三個欄位在下游全部消失

issues.text: Several small readability issues: method should be a const, Create returns an err that is always nil, a const is declared in an odd position, and comments are out of sync with the implementation.
issues.zh: 幾處小的可讀性問題：method 應為 const、Create 回傳必為 nil 的 err、const 宣告位置、註解與實作不同步

issues.text: The way the test Prometheus registry is declared is inconsistent across three files.
issues.zh: 測試用的 prometheus registry 宣告方式在三個檔案間不一致

issues.text: go.work.sum adds a fully duplicate line and drags in dependencies unrelated to this change.
issues.zh: go.work.sum 新增一行完全重複的項目，並夾帶與本次變更無關的相依

open_questions.text: Update no longer wraps objInfo with updateWrapper and instead hands the raw objInfo straight to Legacy.Update — will the two stores still end up writing consistent content?
open_questions.zh: Update 不再用 updateWrapper 包住 objInfo，改成把原始 objInfo 直接交給 Legacy.Update，兩個 store 最後寫入的內容還會一致嗎？

open_questions.text: Could the goroutine and the apiserver's response serialization holding the same obj/options pointers concurrently constitute a data race?
open_questions.zh: goroutine 與 apiserver 的回應序列化同時持有 obj / options 指標，會不會構成 data race？

open_questions.text: Is options.Kind almost always an empty string on real requests, causing all metrics to pile into the kind="" series?
open_questions.zh: `options.Kind` 在真實請求上是否幾乎都是空字串，讓所有 metric 都塞在 kind="" 這一條序列裡？
